<documents>
<document id="support-contact">
Contacting support
Here's how to reach us.

## Chat in the app

Tap Help, then Message us. Chat is open around the clock, every day. It's the fastest way to reach us, and we already know it's you because you're signed in.

## Phone

Call +1 555 0142 from 8:00 AM ET to 8:00 PM ET, every day. You'll be asked to confirm a code in the app to prove it's you.

## Email

Email support@tallowbrook.example if you can't sign in. We reply by email, but for your security we can't make changes to your account by email.

## Specialist teams

Some requests go to a specialist team, such as Fraud, Disputes or Verification. They reply within 2 business days.

## Beware of fakes

Only use the contact details in the app or on this help center. Scammers post fake support numbers online.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="products-checks">
Checkbooks, cashier's checks and money orders
Tallowbrook doesn't offer paper checkbooks, cashier's checks or money orders.

## Paying someone who needs a check

Options include BrookPay (if they're a Tallowbrook member), an ACH transfer to their bank account, or a wire. Many landlords accept ACH.

## Depositing checks

You can deposit paper checks made out to you by taking a photo in the app. See "Depositing a check in the app".

## Money orders

We can't issue money orders, and money orders can't be deposited through the app.

## Closing balance checks

The only time we mail a check is when you close your account without a linked external account. We send the remaining balance by check.

## Direct deposit forms that ask for a voided check

Use the pre-filled direct deposit form in the app instead. It has everything a voided check would show.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="cushion-premium">
Cushion on Premium
On Premium, Cushion covers debit card purchases up to $200 below zero, with no fee.

## Turning it on

Go to Profile, then Cushion. You need at least $500 in direct deposits in the last 30 days. If you stop meeting that, Cushion pauses until you do again.

## Example

If your balance is low and you buy groceries that cost more than you have, Cushion covers the difference as long as the total below zero stays within $200. A purchase that would take you past $200 below zero is declined.

## Limits

Cushion covers debit card purchases only. It never covers ATM withdrawals, transfers or wires.

## Repaying

Your next deposit repays it. If you stay negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended. If the balance is still negative after 60 days, the account is restricted until it's repaid.

## Cost

Cushion has no fees and no interest ($0.00). It isn't a loan and isn't reported to credit bureaus.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.
</document>
</documents>
